The soleplate lacks the expected micro-texture of steam holes or brushed metal grain, appearing overly smooth and 'plastic-like' despite being metallic, likely due to generative smoothing.
Yellow text overlay reads 'Samad' or similar, but the characters have irregular strokes and inconsistent spacing, typical of AI-generated text artifacts.
The geometry of the background items is slightly warped and lacks rigid straight lines, indicating weak geometric consistency in the background.
